name: Gravel V3 WheelTop EDS 2×12

editorial.verdict: Exceptional complete-bike value. A self-build with comparable electronic hydraulic parts costs materially more.
caveats: Proprietary electronic drivetrain has a smaller service network than Shimano

claimed_complete_weight_basis: Exact official regional WheelTop EDS TX listing; size, pedals, accessories and weighing method were not stated
purchase_route: Current official regional store lists the exact WheelTop EDS TX complete build at US$1,750 and exposes ordering; Shenzhen manufacturer contact provides a direct inquiry route. Confirm current mainland SKU, stock, warranty, shipping and selected-option checkout before paying.
